artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan: z-anchored lift, nxt-exposing deletion theorem, residual-inequality decision gate, branch-selected single-block downward assembly, record and full gate.

memory_candidates.content: In the RaySummary ladder layer, the deadline register between pins is constrained only by Drift (1-Lipschitz) and by the pin equation cntAt (u+1) = nxtAt u at region starts; nothing bounds the register's growth toward the next region from the countdown or Tc. Any lift of a surgically altered walk that must HOLD the register at a position z therefore owes exactly one inequality per direction at the first region start above z's region: the lower direction follows from the gap hypothesis n + l <= cntAt g z, while the upper direction (register at the first pin <= n + distance - l) is a genuine side condition a climbing register refutes. Plan the forward-slack hypothesis as a named def on that single pin rather than searching for a landed discharge.
